# phux

> Builder entry points for phux. The hosted index,
> https://docs.phux.sh/llms.txt, is a different file maintained in
> no-phux/website; https://docs.phux.sh/llms-full.txt is every hosted page.

## Entry points

- [Build on phux](./building.md): the hub, version rules, and building a client.
- [Versioned `--json`](./scripting.md#json-output-and-errors) and the [CLI reference](./reference/cli.md).
- [MCP](./agents.md#mcp) (`phux mcp`, stdio) and its [parity table](./reference/parity.md).
- [`phux watch`](./scripting.md#watching-events): one JSON object per line; `--after` resumes.
- [Server protocol](./protocol.md), [compatibility](./compatibility.md), and [`wire-schema.json`](./spec/wire-schema.json).
- [Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501)](./program-protocol.md): report status from any program.
- [Plugin API: build extensions for the phux terminal multiplexer](./plugins.md):
  a `phux-plugin.toml` manifest whose commands run as separate processes.
- [Resource kinds](./resource-kinds.md): publish your own with `phux agent doc serve`.
- [Agent integrations](./agents.md#agent-setup).
- [Calling phux from a program](./agent-quickstart.md#call-phux-from-a-program) and [Embed phux](./embedding.md).

## Facts

Agent state is evidence-ranked; screen is the floor.
It has not been measured on a live Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, or pi session.
There is no public SDK. There is no JSON socket. There is no example application.
The static plugin index is built from the GitHub topic `phux-plugin`.
